QML has discovered significant copper mineralization in an area beyond Mt Chalmers, indicating a potentially valuable new exploration prospect in the region. The discovery suggests expansion of copper-bearing zones outside previously known mining areas, which could represent an important addition to QML's resource base. This find demonstrates the company's successful exploration efforts and potential for further mineral deposits in the broader Mt Chalmers district.
